task: Translate an English text file into Spanish without uploading it
packaging_note: Uses Argos' English-to-Spanish package, pinned by SHA-256. Inference is offline on CPU.

inputs.what: English text in a UTF-8 file

known_issues: This recipe is English to Spanish only. Review names, specialist terms and numbers before relying on a translation.
licence: Argos Translate MIT; the upstream English-to-Spanish model is MIT/CC0 (maintainer clarification in issue 533).
